profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Place Exchange

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed, scaled, and automated key features of PerView, Place Exchange's core data and measurement offering for out-of-home advertising publishers (https://www.placeexchange.com/perview-sellers)
- Drove migration of key parts of the platform to gRPC based microservices deployed on Kubernetes and AWS
- Led initiatives to enhance user data privacy by implementing comprehensive data cleansing and sanitization processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. privacy regulations
- Headed the integration of Place Exchange's API with key advertising and data partners by addressing and fulfilling their unique requirements for custom features and configurations

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
- Delivered platform features that enabled advertisers to programmatically purchase digital video advertising on outdoor media, resulting in a 20% year-over-year increase in monthly revenue.
- Led data engineering initiatives to develop a scalable reporting infrastructure, enhancing the efficiency of internal operations and analytics teams.
- Managed cross-team feature and roadmap requests, effectively streamlining the team's agile planning and delivery processes

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Designed A/B tests to measure changes to advertising buying algorithms. Implementation of tested methods resulted in a 20% increase in revenue for Criteo's trade mark supply side product
- Developed self-service analytics tools empowering sales and account management teams to perform independent account analysis

educations.fieldOfStudy: International Studies; Minors in Entrepreneurship & Management and Financial Economics
